17 March 2026

Economic Bulletin Issue 1/2026

Prices and costs

Inflation is projected to average 2.0% in 2026.

Risk assessment

Risks to economic growth were broadly balanced.

Upside risks to inflation remained, mainly reflecting energy and food prices.

Risks to the growth outlook were tilted to the downside.

The risks surrounding the outlook remained elevated.
